WHY CHASING HAPPINESS DOESN’T WORKhttps://staging.api.fanfares.live/cdn/111f3076ff94c5932dde1956381a76f12c7940799449dd658a5993498919d852.png

We’re told to pursue happiness, yet almost no one notices that it fails the basic requirements of a real goal — clarity, measurability, actionability, and control. Open this note to see why that makes happiness unworkable, and to discover what to aim for instead if you want the benefits people hope happiness will bring.
